minimal_rules: At least one actual accepted ordinary manual dispatch; every historical empty receipt step must have exact immutable ACCEPT plus initial CREATE proof and consistent parent/Case/Run/owner/tenant/service/executor/version/hash binding.

Any historical receipt row or receipt action other than CREATE, non-initial step revision/state/current receipt, missing/corrupt binding, legacy direct create, isolated source, fulfillment/external acceptance or local-close history denies cancellation.

Keep parent UPDATE -> dispatch -> Case -> local ledger order; SUBMIT parent SHARE and business guard before step write. Cancellation winning forbids late receipt writes and original write-key POST replay; SUBMIT winning leaves history that forbids cancellation.

Use distinct new action/scope/API with current owner READ/PREPARE and write EXECUTE, exact Case and material/local revisions plus full source SHA, original key and explicit reason/boolean; cancellation event and persistent state are one transaction. Lost response uses original-key GET only.
Preserve accepted/CREATE/source/plan/resource histories, claims and capacity; no fabricated withdrawal, restoration, implicit plan mutation, resource release or adapter authority.

observations.text: ACCEPT inserts an AWAITING_RECEIPT revision-1 empty step and an immutable CREATE event. CREATE is not a submitted receipt. Legacy CREATE inserts an empty step without actual ACCEPT and must not qualify.

REOPEN returns to AWAITING_RECEIPT while retaining current_receipt_id. New-material ACCEPT and pending manual handoff retain old accepted offers and receipt generations. Full history of both preparation_id and case_id is necessary.

Ordinary SUBMIT takes parent FOR SHARE before Case write guard and receipt-step FOR UPDATE; ACCEPT, handoff, material, plan and resource writers take the same parent before their guarded write. Cancellation parent UPDATE before dispatch/Case/local provides the intended serialization barrier if retained.

New cancellation module checks every selected historical step, any service_step_receipts, any non-CREATE receipt event, initial step state/revision/current_receipt_id, actual ACCEPT and CREATE base-field proof; all bounded-query overflows fail closed. New action/scope preserve old before-ACCEPT API semantics.

Existing cancelled Case write guards cover executor and receipt parent bypasses and trusted resource composition. Historical plan GET suppresses implicit invalidation writes. Independent resource release is outside the Case write guard and remains a separate authorized action.

risks_sent_to_parent.text: Initial ACCEPT/CREATE proof compares base fields but not all handoff/new-material lineage extension fields. A corrupt CREATE predecessor field appears able to pass basic validation. Check typed equality and correct historical predecessor binding for extension fields; do not use latest/fresh-only helper as proof of all generations. This is a static suspicion, not an executed reproduction.

Provider attachment is insufficient to identify isolation after cold plain Store reload. Any persistent non-null managed_access relevant to bound Run, including inactive preserved metadata, must deny ordinary cancellation. No existing receipt rows does not prove no adapter source.

Before-ACCEPT cancellation never exposed a cancelled accepted empty step. New slice requires explicit cancelled historical projection, disabled manual/adaptor submissions and owner receipt actions, cancellation-aware list/read messages, and late GET/POST UI responses unable to revive actions. Parent has added Case/can_submit projection; UI still under implementation at read time.

Original gate only accepts schema max 29/30. Schema31 must be supported narrowly while retaining29 prerequisite and all ordinary/isolated checks to avoid accidentally disabling the existing handoff feature.
